## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds and `npm run test:e2e` passes
- [ ] If this adds a detector: tests for what it should match **and** for the
      near misses it must not claim
- [ ] Its confidence is honest about how much the shape of the text supports it
- [ ] No network calls, no new permissions, nothing stored
